description: Build a link that opens OrbitStudio Sky with the night sky over a place on Earth at a local date and time, as a 3D-printable star map plate. Use it for a birth, wedding or 'night we met' star map. Give a place name, which is looked up on OpenStreetMap, or latitude and longitude, which win when both are given. When a name matches more than one place, the tool lists them instead of choosing: ask the user which one they mean.

label.description: Optional text engraved on the plate instead of the place name.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees. Give it with longitude instead of a place name; it wins over one.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees east (negative is west).

place.description: The place on Earth, e.g. 'Amsterdam, Netherlands'; adding the region or country avoids a list of candidates. Looked up when latitude and longitude are not given. Also the label engraved on the plate (first 40 characters) unless label is given.

name: star_map_link
title: Star map link
